notes.title: Time Riggers is out with a new scoring mode and 3 new levels !
notes.content:
Time Riggers has just been released, and we have added a new game mode.

The new levels have a special scoring system :  in the Arena building we count the number of cherries you have collected before getting out. Only the best players will be able to collect them all. You have a chance to write your name in the leaderboard !

Also, there is a hidden cheat mode that can be used to find a solution in difficult puzzles. Entering the cheat mode disables the save and leaderboard systems so please restart the game after using it.

We hope you will have fun with this update of Time Riggers !

Julien @ CocoMimi Games
